narrative_summary: The market is Late Bull / Topping and today produced the clearest stall signature of the advance: a third consecutive non-extension session, a -0.18% close at 7,709.96 inside a flat 7,700-7,760 shelf beneath the unconfirmed 7,793.68 swing high. Beneath that flat price, 5-day money flow has cratered from ~91 to ~22 and daily RSI has bled from ~84 to ~60, while McClellan breadth (938) and net new 52-week highs (1.12) sit at cycle-low participation — classic narrow-leadership distribution. Valuation offers nothing: ERP is 0.26% at the valuation ceiling with the confirmed re-entry floor 4.7% below spot, and the Monte Carlo edge has decayed to a 50.35% coin flip, failing the 70% Late Bull threshold for an eleventh straight session. Credit (junk 1.24) and volatility (VIX 15.15) remain benign, so this is a stall rather than a break — the correct posture is trim bias and patience, not defense or deployment.

conflicting_evidence.bullish_read: Price has refused to give ground for three sessions, holding within 1% of the all-time high and above all fib levels; a money-flow reset from ~91 to ~22 without price damage can relieve overbought conditions and set up a continuation leg.
conflicting_evidence.bearish_read: MFI falling to the ~22 buy-watch zone while price makes and holds a marginal high is a textbook bearish money-flow divergence and confirms institutional selling into a stationary tape — distribution, not consolidation.
conflicting_evidence.framework_rule: Bearish divergence: price makes a higher high while MFI or RSI makes a lower high. MFI falling below 50 during a decline confirms institutional selling pressure. Longer-timeframe divergences carry more weight.

conflicting_evidence.bullish_read: McClellan has turned up to 938.24 off the 856-874 shelf and now sits above its reference line, a first sign of participation broadening; net new highs remain positive at 1.12.

conflicting_evidence.framework_rule: When breadth and credit both diverge from price, elevate caution even if price has not yet broken down; headline strength with weak breadth indicates narrow leadership.

primary_tension: A structurally intact, credit-confirmed bull skeleton at record price (50-day above a rising 200-day, junk spread 1.24 at year-lows, VIX 15.15, price above every fib level) is colliding with the most complete internal rollover of the entire arc: three consecutive non-extension sessions in a flat 7,700-7,760 shelf beneath an unconfirmed 7,793.68 high, 5-day MFI collapsing from ~91 to ~22 while price held flat, net new 52-week highs at 1.12 and McClellan at 938 in cycle-low participation, ERP compressed to 0.26% inside the valuation-ceiling band with the re-entry floor 4.7% below spot, extension at +9.44% with exhaustion Moderate, and the Monte Carlo edge decayed to a 50.35% coin flip that fails the 70% Late Bull threshold for an eleventh consecutive session.
